pages.title: The Sandstone Gate
pages.text: Build a complete rectangular frame from plain Sandstone. Its opening may be 2-21 blocks wide and 3-21 blocks high. Ignite it with Flint and Steel to travel between the Overworld and Duat.$(br2)Cut Sandstone, Red Sandstone, and other variants do not count.

pages.title: Duat Ore Strata
pages.text: Highly unstable Fractured Phase Ore forms in Duat's sandstone strata at roughly lapis-like rarity. The other three dimensions have variants matching their native stone.$(br2)Its chunks require a falling-anvil press.

pages.title: The Silent Court
pages.text: The court sleeps deep in Duat. Ancient wards prevent ordinary block placement and breaking within its bounds. Only a player wearing the Seal of Kadesh may cross its boundary.

pages.name: Guardian of the Court
pages.text: Find the Skeleton Skull designated as the ritual focus inside the court and right-click it. The summoning starts only if no nearby ritual is active and no guardian remains alive.
